title: Utility Pass-Through Service Schedules at a Glance: Services Billed and Billing Basis
content:
Every site on the Utility Pass-Through Service is billed on one of six service schedules. The schedule decides which services are read on the site's own submeter and how sewer and trash collection are charged.

## Services and billing basis by schedule

| Service schedule | Water by submeter | Sewer billed as | Trash billed as | Natural gas by submeter | Propane by submeter | Electricity by submeter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule | No | Included in the flat utility fee | Included in the flat utility fee | No | No | No |
| Submetered Water Schedule | Yes | Flat fee | Flat fee | No | No | No |
| Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule | Yes | Metered on water | Flat fee | No | No | No |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule | Yes | Metered on water | Flat fee | Yes | No | No |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule | Yes | Metered on water | Flat fee | No | Yes | No |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | Yes | Metered on water | Flat fee | No | No | Yes |

## What each billing basis means

- **Included in the flat utility fee**: sewer (or trash) is not charged on its own line; it is covered by the single flat monthly utility fee that the Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule bills for water, sewer and trash together.
- **Flat fee**: sewer (or trash) is a fixed monthly charge for the billing period.
- **Metered on water**: sewer is billed on the site's water submeter reading, up to a monthly cap on the water consumption that sewer is charged on.
- **By submeter "Yes"**: the service is billed from the site's own submeter on that schedule. **"No"**: that service is not billed by a submeter on that schedule.

## Reading the card

**Which schedules bill natural gas, propane or electricity?** Each energy service is submetered on exactly one schedule: natural gas on the Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule, propane on the Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule, and electricity on the Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule.

**On which schedules is sewer tied to the water reading?** On the four schedules marked "Metered on water". On the Submetered Water Schedule sewer is a flat fee, and on the Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule it is part of the flat utility fee.

**Is trash ever metered?** No. Trash is either a flat fee or part of the flat utility fee on every schedule.
